_comment: What is in the pot, and nothing else — one quad sunk into the tub, exactly the way vanilla draws
a cauldron's water level. It is a separate model rather than a second copy of block/infuser
because the blockstate applies it as a multipart part: the tub is drawn once for the facing, this
is drawn on top of it when FILLED, and neither file has to know about the other.
The surface sits a pixel below the brim, which is where vanilla puts a full cauldron's water. It
is the readable choice as well as the consistent one: a tub filled to the brim can be read at a
glance from a standing player's angle, where a surface sunk into the pot only shows if you are
looking down into it. One bucket filling the whole tub is vanilla's arithmetic too.
A second brew colour is already rendered as block/infuser_butter (see textures-src/infuser.mctex).
Wiring INFUSING up to it is a copy of this file with one texture changed, plus one line in the
blockstate — the block already carries the property.
